$description: The Stratos design system, extracted from the live source of truth: assets/css/chrome.css (palette + geometry), assets/css/type.css (families, scale, semantic roles) and assets/fonts/MANIFEST.json. Values here are not a restatement of the brief — they are what the site actually renders. Where the brief and the build disagree, the build wins and the disagreement is recorded in $notes.

$notes.brief-vs-build-fonts: The Phase 6 brief specifies ABC Arizona Variable, ABC Diatype and ABC Diatype Mono. None is licensed and none is in the repository. The operating tier is Archivo + JetBrains Mono, both SIL OFL 1.1, self-hosted. When Arizona/Diatype are licensed they are swapped at --font-display / --font-body / --font-mono and nowhere else.
$notes.content-guide-is-stale: CONTENT_GUIDE.md's typography table claims Aboreto is the display face and Instrument Sans is the body face. Both are wrong. Aboreto has exactly one consumer — the wordmark — and Instrument Sans is not in the repository at all. Archivo is display AND body. This file records the built truth.
$notes.archivo-italic: Archivo's italic is a separate file, not an ital/slnt axis. Roman-to-italic is a discrete swap, never an interpolation. No continuous slant is available and none is faked.
$notes.jetbrains-no-width: JetBrains Mono has no width axis, so no mono token asks for one.

color.$description: Seven values. The palette is small on purpose: a black page, an off-white text, one beacon, one highlight. Everything else is a step between them.

ink.role: Panel black. Raised surfaces on void.

signal.role: The beacon. Focus rings, the live altitude readout, one CTA per view. Never a background for body text.

chrome.role: Highlight sampled from the chrome plane in the logo. The Meridian Trace, secondary emphasis.

paper.role: Body text and any surface that has to read as printed.

hair.role: The only border colour. One hairline, everywhere.

line.role: Meridian Trace at rest — chrome, held back.

lit.role: Meridian Trace when the section is live.

$contrast.haze-on-void: 5.1:1   — secondary text, passes AA at all sizes
$contrast.$rule: Signal is a foreground colour and a fill for small inverted elements. A paragraph set on a full-bleed signal panel is off-system.

typography.$description: Three faces, three jobs, and a fourth role that is not a fourth option. A component reaches for a role, never for a family, a weight or a pixel value.

body.job: Everything a visitor reads to understand. Same family as display today, still a separate token, because they are separate roles and they diverge the day Arizona/Diatype are licensed.

mono.stack: 'JetBrains Mono', 'JetBrains Mono Fallback', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace
mono.job: Data. Altitude, stage markers, field labels, metadata, buttons. The monospace is the site's tell — it says the numbers are measurements, not decoration.

mark.job: The wordmark. Exactly one consumer: the word STRATOS in the header, the menu and the footer.
mark.$rule: Aboreto is ALWAYS the wordmark and NEVER anything else. One weight, no italic, no axes — it cannot do what the kinetic typography needs. Setting a headline in it is the single most common way to break the brand.

scale.$description: Fluid between 360px and 1440px. Signature is the only step that keeps climbing on very wide viewports; everything else settles, because a paragraph that grows with the window stops being a paragraph.
scale.label: clamp(0.62rem, 0.6rem + 0.1vw, 0.7rem)

displaySignature.use: The homepage headline, and nothing else on a page. Slightly condensed and heavy — an instrument face, not a poster face.

displaySection.use: The top of a band on any page.

labelTechnical.use: Stage markers, field labels, the small print that reads as instrumentation rather than as prose.

numberAltitude.use: The one number the whole homepage is about. Tabular so the digits do not jitter as it counts.

metadata.use: Project sectors, dates, figures in a table.

form.use: Deliberately the body face at body size. An input smaller than the prose around it is the single most common reason a mobile browser zooms on focus.

wordmark.use: The word STRATOS. Nothing else, ever.

kinetic.$description: The bounds every altitude-driven typographic move is clamped to. Stated once so the engine can never ask for an axis value the font does not have.

language.$description: Hungarian is the source language. Display type carries Á É Ő Ű — set leading loose enough that the accents do not collide with the line above.
language.$rule: latin covers English and German in full (ä ö ü ß are all below U+0100). latin-ext exists for Hungarian's ő (U+0151) and ű (U+0171). An English or German page never downloads latin-ext.

rail.role: The altimeter rail. Fixed left, full height. 0px on the homepage, where the climb IS the page.

ease.role: The one easing curve. Everything that moves uses it.

$rules: Scroll is the input. The altimeter reads the document's real structure, so motion is a readout, not decoration.
Discrete snap without overshoot. No liquid morphs between type states.
Everything collapses under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce. No component opts out.

grain.role: Fixed fractal-noise overlay across the whole viewport. It is what stops a pure-black page reading as an empty div.

planeCursor.role: The cursor is the logo: a chrome paper plane that banks toward its heading. Disabled on coarse pointers.

voice.$thesis: The competition is still in the valley. The site does not describe ascent — it performs it.
voice.$register: A good technical partner in a meeting: specific, unhurried, slightly blunt, never impressed with itself.
do: Lead with the outcome, then the mechanism.
Use real numbers, real place names, real client names.
Say the uncomfortable thing when it is true.
Keep sentences short enough to read on a phone at arm's length.
dont: solutions, leverage, synergy, cutting-edge, game-changing, digital transformation, in today's fast-paced world
Claim awards, partnerships or certifications that do not exist.
Write a paragraph where a clause will do.

languages.hu: Source language. Informal te. Direct, a little dry.
languages.en: International, not American. Plain over promotional. No exclamation marks.
languages.de: Formal Sie. The Hungarian bluntness becomes precision instead.
